linked_repos.name: Pokemon_Game_Research
linked_repos.purpose: Obsidian vault with the main research library (PokéBonk, Pokémon Arena 2D, data and asset pipeline, decisions); docs/research in this repository is a dated snapshot of it.
linked_repos.locate: PDL_RESEARCH_ROOT, else the research_root key of the ignored .local/roots.json in the main checkout. Stop when neither is set; never guess from a parent directory.
linked_repos.use: Start from its README.md, which indexes the research by question, and 项目目标与当前决策.md for what is decided; docs/research-snapshot.json here lists the snapshotted sources with SHA-256.
linked_repos.rules: Read and write only through Obsidian MCP or CLI after verifying the vault. The snapshot here never overwrites the vault automatically; a sync compares source and target and records the actual file list.
